trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guideFull: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills to your laundering contacts until the earned total reaches the figure in the description; this is an earner that builds over the whole game, so start routing bills early instead of grinding at the end (source: official trophy description).
trophies.hint: Route marked bills through your contacts early and keep at it.
trophies.missableReason: Not missable — an earnings total that builds over the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Guide text: our own words from that description — unconfirmed in game

trophies.guideFull: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Ordinary spending counts across every shop, so this usually completes by buying vehicles, clothes and gear you wanted anyway; check the running total late in the game before forcing it (source: official trophy description).
trophies.hint: Buy the gear and vehicles you want anyway; the total grows on its own.
trophies.missableReason: Not missable — a spending total that only grows.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Guide text: our own words from that description — unconfirmed in game

trophies.guideFull: Purchase all garage properties — 8 by the official list data. Buy each garage as funds allow; properties stay on sale, so this is a money goal, not a missable (source: official trophy description; count from the official list data).
trophies.hint: Buy garages as funds allow; they stay on sale.
trophies.missableReason: Not missable — properties stay on sale until bought.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Guide text: our own words from that description — unconfirmed in game

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guideFull: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it in the app; ten registrations finish the count in the description (source: official trophy description).
trophies.hint: Register vehicles you like in the Scooter Bros app as you find them.
trophies.missableReason: Not missable — registrations only accumulate.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Guide text: our own words from that description — unconfirmed in game
